shows-and-competition/nutcracker/index.h: This week prepares dancers for their Nutcracker audition. Any dancer wanting to put extra focus into their ballet dancing before they audition is encouraged to come dance with us this week.
Auditions have closed for this season.

Rehearsals last 30–90 minutes, depending on the role. We make every effort to accommodate performers’ schedules. Performers may miss no more than two rehearsals. The rehearsal fee is $130 and can be paid under Events on the Register Now! page.
We typically attend three competitions in April and May.
Our teachers choreograph competition dances, with self-choreography available for older dancers.
Large-group dances rehearse during class. Solos, duos, trios, and small groups rehearse on weekends.
shows-and-competition/recital/index.html: We present three shows in early June to showcase what our dancers have been learning in class. Younger classes perform in one show, while some classes perform in all three.
Our gala is an opportunity to support the studio, take part in bidding, and enjoy performances of our competition dances.
